function.name: add_form_question
function.description: Add one question to an existing Google Forms form. The tool asks for explicit Telegram confirmation before adding the question.

form_id.description: Exact form ID returned by create_form or get_form.

type.description: radio/checkbox/dropdown require options; short_text/long_text are free-text answers.

options.description: Answer options. Required and non-empty for radio/checkbox/dropdown; must be omitted for text questions.

correct_answers.description: Correct answers for quiz mode. For choice questions each value must exactly match one of options.

points.description: Points for a correct answer. Optional when correct_answers is provided; defaults to 1.

required.description: Whether the respondent must answer this question.
